children.label: Overview
children.native_scope: The Inventory lane in Lists is the stock overview: on hand, unit cost and value per item.
children.next_step: No low-stock alerts, reorder points or inventory ageing. Nothing writes back to QuickBooks.

children.label: Inventory
children.native_scope: Stock movements recorded in Lists give each item an on-hand quantity, latest unit cost and value.
children.next_step: No weighted-average or FIFO costing, no purchase orders received against them. Nothing writes back to QuickBooks.

children.label: Purchase orders
children.native_scope: Purchase orders appear as a read-only lane on the Lists screen, resolved against this book's suppliers. They are not bills and nothing posts.
children.next_step: Receiving against a purchase order has no native path.

children.label: Item receipts
children.native_scope: An item receipt is recorded in Lists as a receipt movement against the item and date.
children.next_step: Receipts are not matched to purchase orders. Nothing writes back to QuickBooks.

children.label: Sales orders
children.native_scope: Sales orders appear in the same non-posting list; they do not reserve or move stock.
children.next_step: No stock reservation or fulfilment. Nothing books, posts or moves stock, and nothing writes back to QuickBooks.

children.label: Sales Tax
